title: RoundingHalfEven is admitted to the contract domain because it is the reference oracle's own stock configuration default, and it is outside the graded domain because no capture in the corpus was taken at it. An implementation must refuse with ErrNoDiscriminatingVector. The mode is demonstrably live rather than theoretical: the same request put to two tenants differing only in rounding mode returned period-1 interest 20,925.05 under HALF_UP and 20,925.04 under HALF_EVEN, the tie being taken at Money.java:52.
